title: AS2 for-in loop and delete/typeof/instanceof operators
description: Add remaining AS2 language features to the compiler: (1) for(var k in obj){...} loop — compiles to ActionEnumerate2 (0x55) which pushes all keys of obj onto stack as strings ending in undefined; loop pops each key; (2) delete obj.prop / delete varName — ActionDelete (0x3A) or ActionDelete2 (0x3B); (3) typeof expr — ActionTypeOf (0x44), pushes 'undefined'/'boolean'/'number'/'string'/'object'/'function'; (4) instanceof — ActionInstanceOf (0x54); (5) void expr — ActionPop + push undefined; (6) in operator (for membership test in non-for-in context) — ActionEnumerate + linear search (approximation). Add tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/operators.test.ts. Only touches packages/core/src/as2/.
